name: skillmarkdown
description: Production-quality Agent Skills built and checked by SkillMarkdown: researched instructions, references, scripts and trigger tests.

plugins.name: dockerfile-hardening-audit
plugins.description: Reviews a Dockerfile and image, reports findings by severity, and returns a fixed Dockerfile, .dockerignore and scan commands.

plugins.name: github-actions-hardening
plugins.description: Audit GitHub Actions workflows for supply-chain, injection and privilege issues and get a findings table with YAML diff fixes.

plugins.name: iam-least-privilege-review
plugins.description: Audit AWS IAM policies for least privilege, rank findings by severity, and return a tightened policy plus Access Analyzer validation steps.

plugins.name: k8s-manifest-preapply-review
plugins.description: Pre-apply review of Kubernetes YAML: security, resources, probes, images, PDB, NetworkPolicy and RBAC, with severity-ranked findings and fixes.

plugins.name: llm-app-security-review
plugins.description: Audits chatbot, RAG and agent code against OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 and reports ranked risks with fixes and canary test prompts.

plugins.name: nextjs-app-router-seo-audit
plugins.description: Prioritised SEO audit for Next.js App Router apps covering metadata, canonicals, sitemaps, JSON-LD, rendering, images and hreflang, with code fixes.

plugins.name: openapi-breaking-change-report
plugins.description: Diff two OpenAPI 3.x specs, classify each change as breaking, risky or safe, suggest a semver bump and write migration notes.

plugins.name: postgres-slow-query-diagnosis
plugins.description: Reads PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans, finds the real cause of slowness, and proposes indexes, rewrites and a safe way to verify them.

plugins.name: stripe-webhook-reviewer
plugins.description: Audits a Stripe webhook handler and returns ranked risks with concrete code fixes and Stripe CLI test steps.

plugins.name: terraform-plan-risk-review
plugins.description: Scans a Terraform plan JSON for destroys, public S3, open security groups and IAM wildcards, and prints a risk table with a go/no-go verdict.
